structured.approach:
Attempt 3 fixes the one refusal reason. A-2 said amounts were formatted to two decimals "only when rendered". That contradicted the architecture override in requirements/ZD-48600.md, which says JSON between services carries amounts as strings with two decimals.

A-2 now follows the sources. Inside ap_aging the amount is the Invoice amount (Decimal, 2 dp). It travels to ap_portal as a two-decimal string in JSON, and ap_portal shows it to two decimals. It never passes through float. I aligned the D-2026-044 row's result with this wording.

Everything else is unchanged from attempt 2, which already fixed the earlier refusals (title, REQ-02/CMP-P01 references, statement about the agent's role, notification). That includes the pending capability_request for a notification channel. I rewrote both output files in full from the inputs already read this session: the five contracted inputs, requirements/ZD-48600.md, ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and ZD-48455.

claims.text: Intake ZD-48600 came in through the Customer Feedback channel on 2026-10-24 as Zendesk ticket ZD-48600 (sample, synthetic). Its source link is hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/ZD-48600.md.

The ticket has change requests for ap_pipeline (optional paid_date column, delays_by_vendor), ap_forecast (vendor_risk, optional risk argument on build_explanation_request), ap_aging (overdue_with_risk, sorted by days descending then id) and ap_portal (renderOverdueRisk). It also requires an end-to-end proof: feed -> delays -> risk -> overdue list -> portal table.

The entry is linked to roadmap item R-AP-12, 'give AP managers earlier visibility of overdue payables' (Q4 2026 roadmap, AP module, owner PM). It is not linked to R-AP-14 (aging export for finance close).
No regulatory source applies to this change.
The connector inventory states only that no source-system connector is affected by the ap_aging library. The vendor feed v3 change (new optional paid_date column) is not covered by it.

ap_forecast uses provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2, for the payment-delay explanation, and the optional risk argument changes the prompt sent to it. vendor_risk uses no LLM; it is a rule on the predicted delay.

The Invoice amount is Decimal with 2 dp, and JSON between services carries amounts as strings with two decimals. This is consistent with D-2026-044 and L-011, provided the amount never passes through float.
No conflict with prior decisions: the overdue list covers only unpaid invoices (D-2026-050), and day counts are assumed to be calendar days (D-2026-031).
Lesson L-007 applies: the 'more than 30 days past due' rule and the vendor_risk thresholds (> 30, > 10) need explicit boundary tests.
The only approved connector is api:github, and it allows GET only. A capability_request for a notification channel was filed and is pending approval, so no notification was sent.
Open item ZD-48501 uses the same rule, 'unpaid invoices more than 30 days past due', for overdue_summary in ap_aging.
Open item ZD-48211 asks to flag open invoices more than 30 days past their due date as overdue, and says paid invoices should never count as overdue.
Open item ZD-48455 uses 'overdue risk' wording for ap_portal aging rows, with class row-overdue. That is a different table and class from overdue-risk / risk-RISK.
The source item's risk map says there is no finance posting, authentication, tenancy or payment execution in this change, the tier is T2, and the risk label is advisory only.

open_questions: Q-1: The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not available, so the duplicate check covered only the related requirements/ intake files. Can the PM confirm no board item already covers this? Should this item share one overdue definition with ZD-48501 and ZD-48211, or be merged with them?
Q-2: Is the vendor feed (feed v3, new paid_date column) a registered source-system connector that needs an inventory entry or version update? The current inventory mentions only the ap_aging library.
Q-3: A notification channel is pending approval through capability_request. Until it is approved, who notifies the PM of this entry?
Q-4: Should an unpaid row that carries a paid_date be rejected, or should the date be ignored? The ticket only defines rejection for an invalid paid_date.
Q-5: Should renderOverdueRisk HTML-escape the vendor names and ids it renders?
structured.summary:
I rewrote feat.intake and feat.prebacklog for FEAT-ZD-48600. A-2 now matches the architecture override: the amount is Decimal (2 dp) inside ap_aging, travels between services as a two-decimal string in JSON, is shown to two decimals in ap_portal, and never passes through float.

The entry links to R-AP-12. There is no conflict with D-2026-031, D-2026-044 or D-2026-050. No regulatory source applies. The LLM impact is a prompt change only (acme-text-2). Three related open items are recorded: ZD-48211, ZD-48501 and ZD-48455. The connector gap for the vendor feed is raised as Q-2. The notification was not sent; a capability_request for a notification channel is pending (Q-3). Six assumptions and five non-blocking questions are left for the PM gate. Nothing blocks the step.
